question: Does the Phase 73 watch-forensics v2 system (fixes 1-5) catch significantly more AI-generated images than fine-tuned DINOv3 alone on a generator family no HypeVault component has seen, while rejecting at most 3 percentage points more real photos?
scope_limit: Real photograph versus AI-generated image only. No physical-counterfeit or authenticity claim.
development_data: benchmark_v1, benchmark_v2 and Label_0/Label_1 validation are development data for Phase 73. benchmark_v3 is used once.

classes.REAL_PHOTO: Primary image of eBay listings (Browse API, category 31387, price >= 1000 USD, five brands), up to 60 per brand, excluding every listing and image already in benchmark_v1 or benchmark_v2 and every training image. Minimum 30 per brand.

GENERATED.stable_cascade_lite: PRIMARY. stabilityai/stable-cascade-prior (prior_lite, bf16) + stabilityai/stable-cascade (decoder_lite, bf16). Wuerstchen architecture with its own Paella VQ-GAN; no HypeVault component used it. 60 per brand, same prompt templates, seeds base 74000
GENERATED.kandinsky22_v3: SECONDARY. Kandinsky 2.2, new seeds (base 75000), 60 per brand. Kandinsky images were development data for Phase 73, so this set is not an unseen generator.

normalisation: Same as benchmark_v2: centre-crop square, Lanczos to 512 x 512, JPEG q90, metadata stripped; sources below 512 px excluded.
no_peeking: No model, OCR or fusion output may be computed on v3 images until ml_rtx5080/experiments/watch_forensics_v2/fusion_rule.json is written and its SHA-256 recorded. Generated or collected images are not opened for viewing.

systems_compared.watch_forensics_v2: Phase 73 system frozen in watch_forensics_v2/fusion_rule.json, with three outcomes: FAKE, REVIEW, AUTHENTIC

primary_analysis.real_rejected: real photos decided FAKE, with intervals; REVIEW reported separately and never counted as caught or rejected
primary_analysis.paired: exact McNemar, watch_forensics_v2 vs dinov3_alone, on generated images where both give a binary decision

success_criterion: On the primary set, watch_forensics_v2 catches more generated images than dinov3_alone with McNemar p < 0.05, and its real-photo FAKE rate is at most 3 percentage points above dinov3_alone's.
